import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import os

# Set seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

# Sample submission template
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Handle target variable
train_df["target"] = train_df["target"].astype(int)

# Prepare features and targets
features = [f"f_{i}" for i in range(31)]  # Exclude 'id', 'target'
X_train = train_df[features].values.astype(float)
y_train = train_df["target"].values

X_test = test_df[features].values.astype(float)
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Convert categorical feature f_27 to numeric using label encoding
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

le = LabelEncoder()
X_train[:, 27] = le.fit_transform(train_df[f"f_27"].astype(str).str.strip())
X_test[:, 27] = le.transform(test_df[f"f_27"].astype(str).str.strip())

# Split train into train and validation sets for proper validation
X_train_full, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Create Datasets for LGBM
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train_full, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Train LGBM model
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "max_depth": -1,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(period=-1)],
)

# Validate predictions
y_pred_val = model.predict(X_val)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_pred_val)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC Score: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Predict on test set
y_pred_test = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": y_pred_test})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

# Final score calculation
print(f"\nExpected Test AUC-ROC Score: ~{val_auc:.4f}")
